# jsQR 1.4.0

Local QR decoding fallback for browsers without QR support in `BarcodeDetector`.
The library is loaded from the app's own files only after the user chooses Scan preview.
No camera frame or decoded QR text is sent to a server.

- Project: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
- Version: 1.4.0
- Source distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js
- License: Apache-2.0 (included in `LICENSE`)

The original distribution is included without modification.
